description: This script sets up and tests SVN and Git interactions concerning commit message encodings, specifically focusing on non-UTF8 messages and their handling by 'git svn'. It includes test setup, commits, and SVN dcommit attempts with different encoding configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, executes commands within a subshell.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are expected to fail, used to verify error handling.
